klde01.title: Totally Over My Ex
klde01.caption:
The needle did not believe Aries for one second.
Over the ex, sure. The hoodie is a separate case. Who else still sleeps in one?

klde02.title: Thriving at the Holiday Dinner
klde02.caption:
Single at the family dinner and "thriving"? The machine says otherwise.
Taurus loves the rolls. The questions, less so. What's your rehearsed answer this year?

klde03.title: Not Waiting for the Text
klde03.caption:
"I'm not waiting for their text," says Gemini, refreshing for the ninth time.
The only new message was the weather. Be honest, how many times did you check today?

klde04.title: I Deleted Our Old Texts
klde04.caption:
Cancer deleted every old text. Into a folder. Called DO NOT OPEN. Last opened: today.
Missing someone is allowed. Who else has an archive like this?

klde05.title: I Didn't Plan What to Say
klde05.caption:
Virgo is just going to wing tonight's call.
With a script. Draft four. Stage directions included. Which line would you add?

klde06.title: Anywhere's Fine
klde06.caption:
"Anywhere's fine" is the biggest lie ever told at dinner time.
Libra has a menu wall and fourteen pages of pros and cons. What's your one hard no?

klde07.title: Ready to Settle Down
klde07.caption:
Sagittarius is so ready to settle down. The suitcase by the door disagrees.
Tonight's date is in a new city. Tag the friend who calls that romance.

klde08.title: Off the Clock
klde08.caption:
Capricorn swears there's no work on date night. There's a laptop under the tablecloth.
To be fair, they also took notes on the date's order. Sweet or a little too much?

klde09.title: Their "ok" Means Ok
klde09.caption:
Aquarius is totally calm about the "ok." Ignore the theory board with red string.
Plot twist: it meant ok. How long do you stare at a one-word reply?

klde10.title: Ten Questions, Zero Secrets
klde10.caption:
Scorpio says they have no secrets. Ten questions later the machine is begging for a break.
Stay for the last answer. Which lie got you?

klde11.title: Doesn't Care What People Think
klde11.caption:
Leo doesn't care what anyone thinks. Ten questions, seven outfits and one spoon say otherwise.
The verdict is kind of sweet, though. Which answer was the most Leo?

klde12.title: I Won't Cry This Time
klde12.caption:
Pisces promised not to cry this time. The tissues ran out by question two.
Even the machine got emotional. What's the last thing that made you happy-cry?

klne01.title: Good Morning, Recorded at Midnight
klne01.caption:
When your goodnight lands in the middle of their night, it can feel like you keep missing each other.
Leave a voice note for their morning instead. It's waiting when they wake up.
